text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Fan Appreciation Festival is here! To 
entertain the fans who always support 
them, the Umamusume put on a variety of 
events.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the event Vivlos chose was—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainy, I'm gonna go give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes only on me! And cheer for 
me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—And now, we're finally down to the 
finals! The 'My Little Sister 
Championship'!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume of Tracen Academy possess a 
wide variety of personalities. And among 
them, this event focuses on the "little 
sister" archetype—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The number-one little sister is about to 
be decided!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, will our little sisters advancing 
to the finals please come up to the stage!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —I just knew it would turn out like this♪

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Can a little sister really be this 
amazing?! Reigning supreme with 
magnificent cuteness, the inaugural Little 
Sister Champion, Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The one challenging Curren is... you, 
riding high on your momentum♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Curren-san! It's such a huge honor!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Challenging the absolute champion is 
Vivlos! Can the ultimate younger sister, 
with two older sisters of her own, finally 
break through this wall of cuteness?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You know, I've worked hard all the way up 
until today just for this event!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
As your little sister... I won't lose no 
matter what!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Go easy on me, okay? Curren-san ♡

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"The pleasure's mine ♡ Let's get along, 
okay, Vivlos-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: *staaaare.*

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: *staaaaare...*

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Neither side is backing down an inch...! 
It appears the match has already begun!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, Vivlos. I know you can 
definitely win!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Because without a doubt, you and Cheval 
are the cutest little sisters ever."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Curren-san remains undefeated in this 
tournament, however."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Ayabe-san, are you here to cheer 
for Curren-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "I just happened to be passing by."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... Then you wouldn't mind, would you? 
Even if our Vivlos defeats Curren-san, 
that is."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Go right ahead, as you please.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“—It seems everyone is ready! Now then, 
let's announce the theme for the finals!”

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, "begging"! A charm that 
makes people want to give you anything you 
ask for is the ultimate weapon fit for a 
little sister!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoever gets the louder scream from the 
crowd wins! They'll be crowned the number 
one little sister this time!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Leading off is the absolute champion, 
Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Okaaay.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's see... Since our opponent is 
Vivlos-chan...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Verxina-saaan! Please come over here 
for a second!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "...Huh!? W-Why—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big sis.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I know you already have a precious little 
sister of your own, big sis.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, Curren wants to be Big Sister's 
little sister, too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Is that a no...? Big sis?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
W-What is this...!? Curren Chan takes the 
fight straight onto her opponent's home 
turf! Already a champion, yet what a 
voracious spirit!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Cute Curren Chan!!!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The screams of the audience have reached 
us! We are now measuring the volume!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh! Begging Big Sis like that...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: No way! She's MY big sister!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos is completely worked up right now. 
At this rate, she won't be able to calmly 
give her usual "pleas"...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis, don't!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: You're my big sis, after all!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Honestly, Vivlos. Isn't that just 
obvious?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Still, perhaps I shouldn't have stepped 
down from the stage.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, since Vivlos-san stepped 
out of bounds, she loses by default.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?! Was that really the rule?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Never stepping down from the stage of 
one's own accord. Being the star... that 
is another true quality of a little 
sister!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I don't get it at aaaaall!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Still, whatever. As long as Onee-chan 
loves me the most! ♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
……Having one more little sister wouldn't 
be so bad, though.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu, just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, I never really figured out 
what kind of sport that was supposed to 
be... but Vilshina looks satisfied, so 
let's call it a win.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big siiis!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainie! B-But, Big Sis did it!
choice_data_list:
You're going to be the number one little 
sister, right?

You're going to be the number one little 
sister, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't quite understand, but apparently 
Vivlos has worked hard for this day... In 
that case, I must calmly find a path to 
victory."
choice_data_list:
When it comes to "begging," you're 
undefeated.

When it comes to "begging," you're 
unbeatable.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainy...
choice_data_list: (What in the world am I saying...?)
(What in the world am I saying...)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I've begged for everything 
I've ever wanted up until now, after all!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Trainie! I'm all good now!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Viblos is the one taking on the challenge! 
Now, what kind of sweet pleading will she 
show us?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'll just treat everyone like my big 
sister and beg them for stuff!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big Sis! I want to be your number one!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Will you... come to love me?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: ...! Uwoooohhh!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: I am... I'm...! Vivlos's big sister!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos, what a frontal assault! This is 
begging at its finest! The strongest, 
ultimate little sister~!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
What are these people talking about? 
Vivlos's older sisters are only me and 
Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Curren-san. Your excessive pride 
became your downfall, didn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"We are measuring the cheers right now! 
Now then, who will be the victor...!?"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—It's Vivlos! Vivlos takes it! Defeating 
the absolute champion, she has become the 
nation's little sister!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yaaay~~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, I lost! But you know what? I'm 
still happy♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Cuteness can be polished even further with 
strong rivals. Let me have my revenge next 
year, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Of course! But I'm definitely not gonna 
lose, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos & Curren
text_block_list.text: *staaaare...*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Vivlos became the number-one 
little sister for the umpteenth time...?
